text: {"memo": "Salesforce delivered a solid FY2025 performance, generating $37.90\u202fbillion in revenue and $6.20\u202fbillion in net income, up from $34.86\u202fbillion and $4.14\u202fbillion respectively in FY2024. Operating income rose to $7.21\u202fbillion versus $5.01\u202fbillion a year earlier, while diluted EPS increased to $6.36 from $4.20 and operating cash flow climbed to $13.09\u202fbillion from $10.23\u202fbillion. This translates into roughly 9\u202f% revenue growth, a 50\u202f% jump in net income, 44\u202f% higher operating income, a 51\u202f% rise in EPS, and 28\u202f% more operating cash flow year over year. Margins have tightened significantly: net margin improved to about 16\u202f% from 12\u202f% in FY2024, and operating margin expanded to roughly 19\u202f% from 14\u202f%. The combination of double\u2011digit top\u2011line growth and robust margin expansion underscores Salesforce\u2019s continued execution and pricing power. View: Strong growth and margin improvement support a buy rating."}
